correctness.rationale: From every zero vertex needing a capable opposite-shore defender, with z zeros on that shore, any unique capable defender cannot have its matched nonneighbor be a zero and pays ceil(z/p) above baseline; two or more capable defenders lose at most one zero neighbor each and pay at least 2ceil((z-1)/p). This gives W_A>=r-z_A+phi_p(z_B), W_B>=s-z_B+phi_p(z_A). With p>=3, m>=3 and z<=m-1, H_m(z)>=1+ceil((m-1)/p); all-zero shore boundaries are checked separately. Two positive opposing defenders, endpoints of one missing edge for t>0 or any actual edge for t=0, attain the bound and respect label codomain including perfect matching. Own independent exhaustive definition-level labelings on small (r,s,t,p) confirm values; general proof analytic.
